cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the sofa down. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry; I'll show you how to approach them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lower your voice. That's a response, not permission to grab them. Put the cushion down and apologise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologise, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. An apology followed by a search is an accusation. Leave the cushion alone and tell them you trust them to come out.

reason: Keep the ordinary clue and checking compromise; A's etiquette corrections insist on abandoning search entirely.
